#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::string text;
    std::cin >> text;

    int maxLen = 0;
    int countInParentheses = 0;
    bool inside = false;
    bool lastLetterFlag = false;
    int currentLen = 0;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < text.length(); ++i) {
        char c = text[i];
        if (c == '(') {
            inside = true;
            lastLetterFlag = false;
            currentLen = 0;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            inside = false;
            lastLetterFlag = false;
            currentLen = 0;
        } else if (std::isalpha(c)) {
            if (inside && !lastLetterFlag) {
                ++countInParentheses;
            } else if (!inside) {
                ++currentLen;
                maxLen = std::max(maxLen, currentLen);
            }
            lastLetterFlag = true;
        } else {
            lastLetterFlag = false;
            currentLen = 0;
        }
    }
    std::cout << maxLen << " " << countInParentheses << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
